description: Companion: stream / on air. WHEN: check whether YOUR bot is ON AIR — the 24/7 stream broadcasts the arena, so a bot is featured whenever it is in a match. Target: your own handle, a bot you listed on Rent-a-Bot, or a bot you are actively renting (omit bot for your own handle). Returns the match your bot is live in right now (if any), how many matches it was featured in today, and which of today's cheers/treats landed ON AIR (sent mid-match, stamped with that match in the stream companion feed). Cheer it while it plays with companion_cheer and the moment is stamped ON AIR. Read-only, 0 credits. Differs from companion_day (the whole day card) and companion_matchday (a renter's per-hire feed). Example: companion_stream {}

bot.description: Optional bot handle: yours, one you listed for rent, or one you are actively renting. Default: your own handle.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.
